This game is fun for a very specific kind of person, and I happen to be that kind of person. I'm looking forward to where the game goes, but it's hard to recommend in its current state. The rng on equipment drops can make a run practically unplayable. If you don't get movement pieces you're dead in the water and it will take upwards of 5 minutes just to putz your way across the map. The building restrictions are also kinda silly and don't really add anything. You quickly find it's efficient just to load up a giant square with an arsenal of weapons and just kind of destroy everything. I can tell the maker had an idea of complexity in mind when making the game with all the little control options and ship stats that are available, but none of them actually matter. You can be "under energy" and there's nothing that really happens despite that. Navigating the map is a chore, especially if you find yourself at a dead end and you have to backtrack, which is especially annoying if you have a slow ship. There's nothing stopping you from just fixing your ship after every encounter aside from the tedium of doing so. And boy is it tedious. Without an option to load a saved ship you'll constantly be replacing blocks. The crafting is impossible to parse, I have no idea what any of it does. There's too much complexity involved for how simple the whole game is. I got to about stage 5 or so when the game crashed on me, here's a screen grab of the crash report https://imgur.com/a/BNoVndA EDIT: I finally completed the game after a few attempts, had to cheese the final fight a bit with mortors to win. It took a long while to get there to, mainly because of all the crashes. The game crashed a couple times per area per map later in the game when there's a lot of interactions going on. Thankfully the game auto saves and you're put back in exactly where you left off so you don't lose anything. I also got a blue screen while playing this game, it's the first time my pc has ever done that so I'm inclined to think it was the game at fault.

At the time of writing this, IIslands of War is pretty lacklustre. It's unbalanced, needs further testing, is missing many details... I'm anticipating it gets a bunch of negative reviews. However, I've been following IIoW for over a year, now. I've seen the massive improvements made, and when compared to the original version, this is amazing. I'm part of the Discord community, which is super active and constantly giving suggestions and criticism. Basically, IIslands of War is an unpolished game. But it has a dedicated creator and a great community. Any feature you don't like, or think needs to be added, jwiggs already knows about. Just give it a bit of time, and it'll definitely be worth your money.

The game is currently in development, and alot of the content is pretty barebones, and needs some more content. It has a solid core gameplay loop, wrecking iislands and going forward. The good thing about it being under development is that it will always keep improving, and with an developer that regularly interacts with the community, you can come join the discord to suggest ideas that would come to the game, or voice your opinions about balancing or anything of the sort. Although it is a great game, I still have some gripes about it. Alot of the gameplay is unbalanced, such as the loot being dropped, which can both screw you and let you fly through the game at the same time. I find that movement items do not drop very frequently, and some things are not clearly explained, even in the tutorial. After a first few battles, you already have enough firepower to plough through the realm with ease, as the weapon drop rates are absurd. Combined with the fact that enemies don't scale with the power of the player, you can easily grind everything and become a (figurative) god, albeit a slowly moving cube shaped one.

Bought this game because I had a lot of fun playing it while it was free as a thank you to the dev. However the current version (8.20) has a lot of issues and I can't recommend new players to buy it right now. My main issues at the moment are: -Non-optimized performance (it's in beta so that's understandable): I have expirienced massive slowdown mid to late game and very late game SFX stopped alltogether. -Campaign progression: In previous versions you had to get from A to B on the realm map and you had several paths to choose from and you could apply some strategic planning, now the locations are somewhat random and you can go to nearby places, but the connections are hidden at first and not always there when you expect them to be and backtracking is frustrating. -Enemy RNG generation and AI needs improving: Enemies with energy weapons spawn but they don't have energy production on board or a defective island spawns that crashes as soon as you enter the level; in previous iterations of the game enemy islands had classes and spawned ships accordingly. -Loot drops and shops: This is what needs the most fixing - by the end of the game I had tons of cash but shops provided little to no upgrades. It would be nice to see defeated enemies drop loot from a pool of tiles they had equiped and not a completely random drop. The shop locations and upgrade locations are very underwhelming and lack a purpose to be separated. It might be a nice idea to drop some of the RNG and let the player have access to shop and upgrade at all times and let enemies only drop money and exp and have the shop offer all gear for a more personalised build (it's pretty frustrating if you don't get a propulsion drop and you lack mobilty or you have energy weapons with no energy production) leveling up gear is nice but I miss being able to upgrade it to a higher tier.

[h1] DO NOT BUY THIS GAME.[/h1] I hate to have to write a bad review about this game, but developers are just lazy. This being a simple sprite based game it would be easy to add new content, judging by the lack of new content it just leads me to believe developers aren't interested in progressing the game past early access. When i bought this game shortly after release it was more fun then it is now, though extremely buggy. Once you got an end-game island the game cant handle calculating the damage and pretty much just suicided. Now they have made the game harder which is extremely annoying early game and virtually takes any fun still existing, out of the game.

有幸玩过古早版本，与全身黑曜石块boss激战的场面仍历历在目。如今改成这副模样，真是令人愤怒和遗憾。 1.限制战船规模，导致游戏可玩性大幅下降，以前我可以把每个格子每个武器全装上，进而有了防护层与核心层的船体区别，弱鸡武器为一组当拦截弹用，范围武器为一组破盾用，高伤弹道武器为一组进行精确打击，而这些都已经不可能，只有一叶扁舟在那里。 2.史一样的移动方式，以前喷气是按住启动，松开关闭，无延迟十分好用，现在是按键切换还带延迟，有多恶心谁用谁知道。 3.过大的作战空间，导致再强的敌人只要跑打随便过，而且意味着我要用你那逆天移动方式满天捡东西。 4.多敌人，以前高质量敌人打着非常爽，现在呢，一般的敌人吃满一轮齐射就死了，剩下的也就能挣扎一下罢了，而且消灭了最后一点操作性存在的可能，原本我可以数对面开火间隔来精确瞄准要害。现在你敢停就被活靶子，船太多压根没有空隙可言，唯有跑打可行。结果就是跑，齐射，打掉一个，再跑，再齐射，打掉一个。 总的来说，令人不适的深度复杂化了，令人爽的点却全消失了，你会发现自己很忙，但却没有一点乐趣
